prev_agent: Those are just plan docs, not runtime config — I'll leave them as historical reference. **Root cause:** The `opensandbox/server:latest` image changed its config path from `/root/.sandbox.toml` to `/etc/opensandbox/config.toml` (env var `REDACTED.toml`). The volume mounts were using the old path, so the config was never read, and the server defaulted to Kubernetes mode. **Fixed in 4 files:** - `Makefile` (line 21) - `docker-compose.yml` (line 28) - `deploy/kustomize/base/opensandbox-deployment.yaml` (line 25) - `deploy/helm/.../opensandbox-deployment.yaml` (line 31) Try running `make dev` again — the OpenSandbox server should now read the Docker config and start successfully.
